title: Scenario-led Decision Log and QBR Playbook (working)
content:
Purpose:
This working playbook is focused on running a scenario-driven QBR that surfaces realistic stakeholder trade-offs and produces a single canonical Decision Ledger at the end of the meeting. Use when the account has active renewal discussion (30–120d) or when we need to convert strategic asks into scoped, prioritized decisions.

When to use: 
- Renewal window open or approaching (30–120 days)
- Multiple internal stakeholders with conflicting priorities
- Technical risk or deployment constraints that require trade-off decisions

Quick note: this is intentionally lightweight — we want an operational decision artifact, not just slide bullets. Treat the Decision Ledger as the source of truth for any follow-ups to include into renewal offers or SOWs.

Pre-meeting checklist (owner: CSM) — must be done 72–24 hours before:
- Confirm attendees: executive sponsor, product owner, infra/tech lead (if applicable), procurement or finance rep when renewal near. If any of these are missing, note backup decision authority.
- Share one-pager (attached) with: 30/60/90 day usage trends, top 3 adoption theses, known technical blockers with short-term mitigations.
- Send pre-read with the three scenarios (A/B/C) and ask each stakeholder to rank their preferred scenario 1–3 in the doc.
- Create a JIRA ticket for any technical follow-up we anticipate (prefix: CS-). Add link to Decision Ledger.
- Prep 2–3 quick demos or artifacts to validate adoption claims (not more than 5 minutes each).

Meeting run-of-show (60 minutes recommended; extend to 90m for larger exec groups):
0:00–0:05 — Opening and objective (Facilitator)
- Script: "Objective for the next 60 minutes: align on one of three realistic scenarios, capture decisions and owners, and surface any blockers that would prevent renewal commitment. We'll end with a Decision Ledger and 3 immediate actions."
- Confirm timekeeper and scribe (name them).

0:05–0:15 — Business outcomes & current signals (CSM + Exec Sponsor)
- Show 30/60/90 adoption trends, value milestones achieved, churn signals (if any).
- Script cue for exec sponsor: "One sentence — what success looks like to leadership in 90 days."

0:15–0:35 — Scenario walkthroughs (Facilitator + Tech lead as needed)
- Structure: Walk through Scenario A (Conservative), B (Balanced), C (Aggressive). Each scenario includes: cost impact, implementation lift, risk delta, measurable success metric.
- For each scenario: 3-minute readout, 2-minute clarifying questions, live vote (stakeholders vote 1/2/3).
- Live vote method: use poll in meeting or ask chat with initials + number. Record votes in the Decision Ledger.

0:35–0:45 — Trade-off quick roundtable (Facilitator invites 2 stakeholders)
- Prompt: "Given the votes and the top risk, what would make you change your vote?" Capture commitable mitigations (owner + ETA).

0:45–0:55 — Decision consolidation & fallback policy (Facilitator + Scribe)
- If majority vote: confirm chosen scenario and list 3 binding decisions (scope, timeline, financial ask).
- If split: apply fallback (default = Balanced/Scenario B unless Exec Sponsor overrides). Document override and rationale.

0:55–1:00 — Decision Ledger summary and next steps (Scribe)
- Read out Decision Ledger entries and immediate actions. Confirm owners and dates. End meeting.

Facilitation scripts (snippets to reuse):
- To surface hidden risk: "Help me understand what would cause this plan to fail in week 1 — what's the single point of friction?"
- To force a trade-off: "If we want the 2x adoption outcome in 90 days, which of these three items are you willing to deprioritize internally?"
- To avoid feature-death-by-committee: "Can we prioritize 1 critical success metric that must move to validate this scenario?"

Decision Ledger template (capture live in the doc/Scribe in first 5 minutes):
| ID | Decision (one sentence) | Chosen Scenario | Rationale (short) | Owner | Due | Risk Rating (H/M/L) | Follow-up artifact (JIRA/PR/link) |
| D-01 | Adopt Scenario B: staged rollout + pilot expansion | B | Balances cost and adoption; Exec Sponsor prefers measured approach | Priya K | 2025-02-20 | M | JIRA:CS-512 |
| D-02 | Start technical hardening sprint (2 wks) | B | Required for low-latency SLAs | Eng: Luis R | 2025-01-28 | H | PR:github.com/org/repo/pull/134 |

Scoring rubric (helpful for quick consensus if votes are tied):
- Risk Rating: High = probable failure without mitigation; Medium = manageable with small ops; Low = nominal.
- Impact: High = >20% user engagement lift or material cost saving (>15%); Medium = 10–20%; Low = <10%
- Effort: High = >3 sprint-equivalents; Medium = 1–3 sprints; Low = quick config changes or infra knobs.

Three scenario examples (editable) — keep these short in the pre-read: 
- Scenario A (Conservative): Extend current pilot for 90 days; limit to 2 teams; no price change; focus on reliability fixes. Metrics: retention +5% at 90d. Effort: Low.
- Scenario B (Balanced): Gradual roll to full team over 60 days; run enablement + one integration; introduce volume-based discount. Metrics: usage +15% at 90d. Effort: Medium.
- Scenario C (Aggressive): Full org rollout in 30 days; premium support & integration package; price uplift negotiated. Metrics: usage +40% at 60d. Effort: High.

Post-meeting action tracker (minimal required fields):
- Action ID (string), Short description, Owner, Due date, Link to artifact (JIRA/Confluence), Status (open/in-progress/blocked/done).
- Quick example: ACT-01 | Run KV cache analysis for latency hotspot | Luis R | 2025-01-22 | JIRA:CS-523 | in-progress

Renewal activation quick-template (for CSM to convert Decision Ledger into commercial ask):
- Chosen scenario + binding commitments
- Pricing ask and payment terms (if applicable)
- Risk mitigations we will include in SOW or appendix
- Success metric and 30/60/90 checkpoints (owner + data owners)
- Exec sign-off line and signature field

Boundaries and escalation: 
- Any decision that changes annual committed spend >10% requires Sales ops/Finance approval and a Sales Ops ticket.
- Any decision that increases latency risk (Risk = High) requires SRE review and SLO addendum.

Notes to self / TODOs (rough):
- [ ] Add live Google Sheet template for Decision Ledger (sheet link placeholder).
- [ ] Draft short email template to send Decision Ledger + commercial ask within 24 hours.
- [ ] Validate fallback policy language with legal for inclusion in SOWs.
- Unresolved question: should Exec override be binding or advisory for accounts < $100k ARR? (ask Sales Ops)

References / links used by the playbook: 
- Confluence: CS/QBR-playbooks-2024 (linked above)
- Jira: CS-482 (customer-specific renewal tracker)
- Slack thread: #acct-456-renewals (captures pre-meeting stakeholder comments)

Appendix: quick facilitator checklist during meeting (one-liners):
- Tell people the decision horizon (what the Decision Ledger will be used for).
- Force a choice (avoid fake consensus).
- Timebox clarifying questions to 2 minutes each.
- If technical dispute persists, mark as "deferred tech decision" and assign SRE + CSM owner with 48h SLA.
- After meeting: publish Decision Ledger and create follow-up JIRA tasks within 24 hours.

End of working draft.

(Working draft — expect edits; aim to standardize across CS playbooks for Q1 2025.)
